module_summary: Parallel-to-serial converter: a 2-bit counter reloads a 4-bit rotating shift register from d every fourth cycle, emitting its MSB serially with a valid pulse.

anchors.name: data
anchors.why: 4-bit shift register loaded from d at cnt==3, rotated left otherwise; MSB drives dout.

anchors.name: cnt
anchors.why: Bit counter; at 3 triggers parallel load and valid pulse, else shift.

anchors.name: dout
anchors.why: Serial output bit, MSB of data shift register.

anchors.name: valid_out
anchors.why: One-cycle pulse marking first serial bit of each new word; copy of valid register.

anchors.name: d
anchors.why: 4-bit parallel input word loaded into data every fourth cycle.

groups.name: shift_register
groups.description: 4-bit rotating shift register converting parallel d into serial dout.

groups.name: bit_counter
groups.description: 2-bit counter sequencing load/shift and generating valid pulse register.
